children: South Africa-based fertiliser maker Omnia Holdings
said on Friday it is in discussions over its potential acquisition by an unnamed entity, sending its shares more than 10% higher at the open.
The Johannesburg-based company, which also manufactures explosives mainly used in mining, said in a statement the talks were advanced, but no agreement has been reached yet.
The company supplies crop nutrients to several African countries and its market capitalisation on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange is about 16.83 billion rand ($1.04 billion).
